RIDGEWAY: In Kent General Hospital, Dover, Del. on February 10,

. Georgianna, wife of Raymond Ridgeway of Dover, Del. Aged. 62 years. Relatives and friends are invited to attend the services at the First Baptist Church, Cheswold, Del. on Thursday afternoon Feb. 15 at 1:00 o'clock. Interment at Immanuel Union Cemetery, Cheswold. Friends may call at the church on Wednesday evening from 7 to 9 o'clock. Arrangements by the Stevenson Funeral Home, Dover, Del.
Ms. Raymond Ridgeway
(no date listed)
DOVER: Mrs. Georgianna  Ridgeway, 62, wife of Raymond Ridgeway of Dover died at Kent General Hospital after a brief illness. She was a member of the First Baptist Church at Cheswold.

Mrs. Ridgeway is survived in addition to her husband by three daughters, Mrs. Sadie Carney, Mrs. Virginia Durham and Mrs. Beatrice Seeney, all of Dover; three sons, Raymond Ridgeway Jr., Greensbury Ridgeway, both of Dover and Spec. 4 Albert Ridgeway stationed at Ft. Bragg, NC;  two sisters, Mrs. Sophia Gould, Bridgeton, NJ and Mrs. Earl Rdigeway, Cheswold; one brother, Albert Mosley, Dover; and 15 grandchildren.
Services will be Thursday afternoon at 1 at the First Baptist Church, Cheswold where friends may call Wednesday night. Interment will be in Immanuel Union Cemetery, Cheswold.
Mike C. Ridgeway
RIDGEWAY: In Dover, Delaware on October 31,

. Mike C. Ridgeway, husband of Caroline Ridgeway of near Cheswold, Delaware. Aged 65 years. Relatives and friends are invited to attend funeral services from the Emanuel Union Church, Cheswold on Thursday afternoon, Nov. 3 at 2:00 o'clock. Interment at Emanuel Union Hill Cemetery. Friends may call from 7 to 9 o'clock on Wednesday evening at the Matthews Funeral Home in Smyrna.
DOVER: Oct. 31- Funeral services will be held for Mike C. Ridgeway, 65, of near Cheswold who died at Kent General Hospital today following a sudden illness.
